class.name: VoxelScene
class.brief_description: Finite voxel volume rendered as a single mesh, editable in the 3D viewport.
class.description: [VoxelScene] holds a fixed-size voxel volume (a [VoxelSceneData] resource) and renders it once as a single [MeshInstance3D] child when the node enters the scene tree. Designed for cinematics, main menus, decorative props, and other static voxel arrangements that do not need streaming, procedural generation, or runtime mutation. Editing happens in the editor through a custom 3D viewport plugin (paint, erase, pick, box fill, box erase tools) and a palette dock listing all blocks of the assigned [VoxelBlockRegistry]. AO (ambient occlusion) is baked directly into vertex colors at mesh-build time when [member bake_ao] is enabled. The runtime API is intentionally read-only ([method get_block], [method get_size]). For dynamic voxel terrain use [VoxelWorld] instead.

method.name: get_block
method.description: Returns the block ID at the given voxel cell, or 0 (air) if out of bounds.

method.name: get_size
method.description: Returns the size of the voxel volume in cells, or [code]Vector3i(0, 0, 0)[/code] if no [member voxel_data] is assigned.

method.name: local_to_voxel
method.description: Converts a node-local position to voxel cell coordinates.

method.name: voxel_to_local
method.description: Converts voxel cell coordinates to a node-local position (corner of the cell).

method.name: rebuild_mesh
method.description: Rebuilds the rendered mesh from the current [member voxel_data] and [member block_registry]. Called automatically when [member auto_rebuild] is enabled and any of the relevant properties change.

members.member: If [code]true[/code], the mesh is rebuilt automatically when [member voxel_data] or [member block_registry] emits the [signal Resource.changed] signal, or when render-related properties are modified.
If [code]true[/code], smooth ambient occlusion is computed per face vertex and multiplied into the vertex color. No additional shader is required — AO is baked into the geometry.
Block definitions used to render this voxel scene. The same resource can be shared with [VoxelWorld] and other [VoxelScene] nodes.
Edge length of one voxel cell in node-local units.
Texture filtering mode applied to all generated materials.
The voxel block data backing this scene. Can be saved as a [code].voxscene[/code] (compact binary) or [code].tres[/code] resource and reused across multiple nodes.
